parsed.text: Summary: Panel p0 current distributions at nodes n0, n1 and n2 are inherited uniform grids (copied prior/completed records) and are not new estimates; p0 current at n3 concentrates blue at cell [1,0] and red at [1,2]. Panel p1 current distributions are inherited completed records and uniform across all four nodes. Conditional candidate records (commands k0, k1, k2) are conditional estimates, not executed events. They change some node estimates: in p0 node n2 every candidate concentrates blue at [0,2] and red at [0,1] with differing peak probabilities across k0,k1,k2; other p0 candidate nodes match the current patterns (n0,n1 uniform; n3 blue [1,0], red [1,2]). In p1 candidates, k0 spreads blue mass across cells [0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3] and red across [0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1] at node n2, while k1 and k2 focus blue at [0,2] and red at [0,1] with different peak strengths. All statements above report only the supplied probabilistic location distributions and their differences across views/commands.
